applicability: Task-document body projection with optional external direct-grant annotation.
conditions: Canonical task reads remain limited to the requested document and graph-named masters.
Grant records use the per-task addressed census.
exclusions: Legacy unaddressed grant fallback may inspect other retained grant records; it is outside the former zero-directory-I/O promise.
Concurrent browser requests and always-on corpus projections have separate costs.
statement: A task-document body read avoids canonical task-corpus enumeration: it opens the requested document and only graph-named master documents, and separately reads the task-addressed direct-grant census for its external plan annotation. Retained legacy unaddressed grant files use the explicitly supported fallback, not a constant-I/O guarantee.
